short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: I swapped them and got the SAME reading!
short_scenes.narration: Volt swaps the battery and the ammeter in his circuit. The reading doesn't change!
That's the reciprocity theorem. In a linear circuit with one source, swapping source and meter keeps the same current.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: And Millman's theorem finds the voltage of parallel sources in one line.
